desc: Gun collectors and sportsmen alike have welcomed the Military Style Series of semi-auto rifles from ARMSCOR. Safe and easy to handle, the M1600 and MAK47/22 series are exact replicas of the famous U.S. Armalite M16 and Russian Kalashnikov AK47 assault rifle. Chambered in less expensive .22 LR High Velocity ammunition, these rifles are excellent for military training and troop marksmanship.
